item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: IBM Spectrum LSF integration with Azure Compute Fleet
item.description:
IBM Spectrum LSF now generally supports integration with Azure Compute Fleet for elastic HPC workload orchestration. The LSF Resource Connector can provision and release Azure compute capacity based on workload demand, extending on-premises LSF environments.

  • Source: Azure Updates
